newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Infrastructure Trust lists at premium.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Infrastructure Trust lists at premium.

text.p: The stapled securities of investment trust Infrastructure Trust of Australia Group on Monday listed at A$1.40, a 40 percent premium to their issue price of A$1.
At 11.15 a.m. (0015 GMT), the trust's units were trading at A$1.36 on volume of 9.2 million units.

Infrastructure Trust of Australia Group (ITA Group) has 300 million stapled securities on issue comprising a unit in each of two unit trusts, Infrastructure Trust of Australia and Infrastructure of Australia.

The group has secured rights to four seed assets, requiring a total proposed investment of A$231.4 million. The assets include interests in Sydney tollways -- the M5 Motorway, the Eastern Distributor, and the M2 Motorway -- as well as Melbourne's City Link tollway.

ITA Group's M5 Motorway interest is made up of direct equity and an agreement to acquire subordinated debt. Its current interests in the M2 Motorway and Melbourne City Link are agreements to acquire equity.

ITA Group has entered into a subscription deed to subscribe for A$93.8 million of equity in Airport Motorway, the preferred proponent to finance, design, construct, operate and maintain Sydney's proposed Eastern Distributor.
In its prospectus, ITA Group said the manager was confident that negotiations would conclude successfully and subscription for equity in the project was expected to occur by May 1997.

In addition to the seed assets, the ITA Group has a first right of refusal to provide up to A$30 million of equity for the Brisbane Airport Rail Link, which is in its early stages of negotiation and development.

ITA Group's board of directors includes two directors who are independent of the trust's sponsor, Macquarie Bank Ltd, and intends to appoint at least one more independent director with appropriate experience.
